description: Ausbreitung des Hochwasser im Jahre 2002 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Recording of flooded areas as a result of the 2002 flood Result from site visits and other sources. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood spread in 2002" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ausbreitung des Hochwasser im Jahre 2002, Hochwasser. The listing shows 2020-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
